title.en: Reading: Schools and Institutes of Learning

intro.en: Two reading passages about how the mosque, the kuttab and the old schools taught Muslims, including the famous Al-Azhar mosque, followed by comprehension and vocabulary exercises. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein do parhne ke tukde hain ke masjid, kuttab aur purane madaaris mein musalmanon ko kaise parhaya jata tha, aur mashhoor Al-Azhar ka zikr bhi hai. Phir samajh aur alfaz ki mashqein hain. Ek ek jumla aaram se parhein.
intro.ar: نَصّانِ عَنْ كَيْفَ عَلَّمَ المَسْجِدُ وَالكُتّابُ وَالمَدارِسُ القَديمَةُ المُسْلِمينَ، وَمِنْها جامِعُ الأَزْهَرِ المَشْهورُ، ثُمَّ تَمارينُ في الفَهْمِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ. اقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: لَمْ يَكُنِ المَسْجِدُ في الماضي مَكانَ صَلاةٍ فَحَسْب، بَلْ كانَ مَدْرَسَةً يَتَعَلَّمُ فيها المُسْلِمونَ القِراءَةَ والكِتابَةَ والقُرْآنَ.
dialogue.tr: lam yakuni l-masjidu fī l-māḍī makāna ṣalātin faḥasb, bal kāna madrasatan yataʿallamu fīhā l-muslimūna l-qirāʾata wal-kitābata wal-qurʾān
dialogue.en: In the past the mosque was not only a place of prayer; it was a school where Muslims learned reading, writing and the Quran.
dialogue.ur: Pehle masjid sirf namaz ki jagah nahin thi, balke ek madrasa thi jahan musalman parhna, likhna aur Quran seekhte the.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ أُقيمَ الكُتّابُ بِجانِبِ المَسْجِدِ، وَخُصِّصَ لِتَعْليمِ القِراءَةِ والكِتابَةِ والقُرْآنِ.
dialogue.tr: thumma uqīma l-kuttābu bi-jānibi l-masjid, wa khuṣṣiṣa li-taʿlīmi l-qirāʾati wal-kitābati wal-qurʾān
dialogue.en: Then the kuttab was set up beside the mosque, dedicated to teaching reading, writing and the Quran.
dialogue.ur: Phir masjid ke saath kuttab banaya gaya, jo parhna, likhna aur Quran sikhane ke liye khaas tha.

dialogue.ar: كانَ الكُتّابُ يُشْبِهُ المَدْرَسَةَ الابْتِدائِيَّةَ في عَصْرِنا الحاضِرِ، وَكانَ الكُتّابُ الواحِدُ يَضُمُّ أَحْياناً مِئاتٍ أَوْ آلافاً مِنَ الطُّلّابِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna l-kuttābu yushbihu l-madrasata l-ibtidāʾiyyata fī ʿaṣrinā l-ḥāḍir, wa kāna l-kuttābu l-wāḥidu yaḍummu aḥyānan miʾātin aw ālāfan mina ṭ-ṭullāb
dialogue.en: The kuttab was like the primary school of today, and one kuttab sometimes held hundreds or thousands of students.
dialogue.ur: Kuttab aaj ke ibtidai school jaisa tha, aur ek kuttab mein kabhi sainkron ya hazaron talib-e-ilm hote the.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ قامَتِ المَدْرَسَةُ بِجانِبِ الكُتّابِ والمَسْجِدِ، وَكانَ التَّعْليمُ فيها مَجّاناً.
dialogue.tr: thumma qāmati l-madrasatu bi-jānibi l-kuttābi wal-masjid, wa kāna t-taʿlīmu fīhā majjānan
dialogue.en: Then the school arose beside the kuttab and the mosque, and teaching in it was free.
dialogue.ur: Phir kuttab aur masjid ke saath madrasa qaim hua, aur usmein taleem muft thi.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتِ الدِّراسَةُ فيها قِسْمَيْنِ: قِسْماً داخِلِيّاً لِلغُرَباءِ، وَقِسْماً خارِجِيّاً لِمَنْ يُريدُ أَنْ يَرْجِعَ في المَساءِ إلى بَيْتِ أَهْلِهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa kānati d-dirāsatu fīhā qismayn: qisman dākhiliyyan lil-ghurabāʾ, wa qisman khārijiyyan li-man yurīdu an yarjiʿa fī l-masāʾi ilā bayti ahlih
dialogue.en: Study had two sections: a boarding section for strangers, and an outside section for those who wanted to return to their family's home in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Parhai ke do hisse the: andar ka hissa pardesiyon ke liye, aur bahar ka hissa unke liye jo shaam ko apne ghar wapas jana chahte the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتْ كُلُّ مَدْرَسَةٍ تَحْتَوي عَلى مَسْجِدٍ، وَقاعاتٍ لِلدِّراسَةِ، وَغُرَفٍ لِنَوْمِ الطُّلّابِ، وَمَكْتَبَةٍ، وَمَطْبَخٍ، وَحَمّامٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa kānat kullu madrasatin taḥtawī ʿalā masjidin, wa qāʿātin lid-dirāsa, wa ghurafin li-nawmi ṭ-ṭullāb, wa maktabatin, wa maṭbakhin, wa ḥammām
dialogue.en: Every school had a mosque, study halls, rooms for the students to sleep, a library, a kitchen and a bathroom.
dialogue.ur: Har madrasa mein masjid, parhai ke kamre, talib-e-ilmon ke sone ke kamre, library, bawarchi khana aur ghusalkhana hota tha.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْ أَمْثِلَةِ ذلِكَ الجامِعُ الأَزْهَرُ، وَهُوَ مَسْجِدٌ تُقامُ فيهِ حَلَقاتٌ لِلدِّراسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa min amthilati dhālika l-jāmiʿu l-azharu, wa huwa masjidun tuqāmu fīhi ḥalaqātun lid-dirāsa
dialogue.en: An example of that is the Al-Azhar mosque, a mosque in which study circles are held.
dialogue.ur: Iski ek misaal Jaami Al-Azhar hai, jo ek masjid hai jismein parhai ke halqe lagte hain.

dialogue.ar: تُسَمّى غُرَفُ سَكَنِ الطُّلّابِ فيهِ بِالأَرْوِقَةِ، فَهُناكَ رِواقٌ لِلشّامِيّينَ، وَرِواقٌ لِلمَغارِبَةِ، وَرِواقٌ لِلأَتْراكِ.
dialogue.tr: tusammā ghurafu sakani ṭ-ṭullābi fīhi bil-arwiqa, fa-hunāka riwāqun lish-shāmiyyīn, wa riwāqun lil-maghāriba, wa riwāqun lil-atrāk
dialogue.en: The students' living quarters there are called arwiqa: there is a riwaq for the Syrians, one for the Moroccans and one for the Turks.
dialogue.ur: Wahan talib-e-ilmon ke rehne ke kamron ko arwiqa kehte hain: Shaami logon ka riwaq, Maghribiyon ka riwaq aur Turkon ka riwaq.

dialogue.ar: كانَ رُؤَساءُ المَدارِسِ مِنْ خِيرَةِ العُلَماءِ وَأَكْثَرِهِمْ شُهْرَةً.
dialogue.tr: kāna ruʾasāʾu l-madārisi min khiyarati l-ʿulamāʾi wa aktharihim shuhratan
dialogue.en: The heads of the schools were among the best and most famous scholars.
dialogue.ur: Madaaris ke sarbarah behtareen aur sab se mashhoor ulama mein se hote the.

dialogue.ar: وَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَجْلِسُ لِلتَّدْريسِ إلّا مَنْ شُهِدَ لَهُ مِنَ الشُّيوخِ بِالكَفاءَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa lam yakun yajlisu lit-tadrīsi illā man shuhida lahu mina sh-shuyūkhi bil-kafāʾa
dialogue.en: Only a teacher whom the sheikhs had testified to as competent would sit to teach.
dialogue.ur: Parhane ke liye sirf wohi baithta tha jis ki qabiliyat ki gawahi mashaikh dete the.

dialogue.ar: وَكانَتِ المَدارِسُ أَنْواعاً: مِنْها مَدارِسُ لِتَدْريسِ القُرْآنِ الكَريمِ، وَمِنْها مَدارِسُ لِلحَديثِ، وَمِنْها مَدارِسُ لِلفِقْهِ وَهِيَ أَكْثَرُها، وَمِنْها مَدارِسُ لِلطِّبِّ، وَمِنْها مَدارِسُ لِلأَيْتامِ.
dialogue.tr: wa kānati l-madārisu anwāʿan: minhā madārisu li-tadrīsi l-qurʾāni l-karīm, wa minhā madārisu lil-ḥadīth, wa minhā madārisu lil-fiqh wa hiya aktharuhā, wa minhā madārisu liṭ-ṭibb, wa minhā madārisu lil-aytām
dialogue.en: Schools were of several kinds: some for teaching the noble Quran, some for hadith, some for fiqh (the most of them), some for medicine and some for orphans.
dialogue.ur: Madaaris kai qism ke the: kuch Quran-e-Kareem padhane ke, kuch hadith ke, kuch fiqh ke (jo sab se zyada the), kuch tibb ke aur kuch yatimon ke liye.

dialogue.ar: وَفي دِمَشْقَ وَحْدَها سَبْعُ مَدارِسَ لِلقُرْآنِ الكَريمِ، وَلِلحَديثِ سِتَّ عَشْرَةَ مَدْرَسَةً.
dialogue.tr: wa fī dimashqa waḥdahā sabʿu madārisa lil-qurʾāni l-karīm, wa lil-ḥadīthi sitta ʿashrata madrasa
dialogue.en: In Damascus alone there were seven schools for the noble Quran and sixteen schools for hadith.
dialogue.ur: Sirf Dimashq mein Quran-e-Kareem ke saat madrase the aur hadith ke solah madrase.

q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq pehle masjid kya thi?

title.en: Grammar A: The defective noun (al-ism al-manqūṣ)

intro.en: A defective noun (مَنْقوص) ends in a ya (ـيِ) with a kasra before it, like القاضي (the judge). Its ya disappears when it has tanween in the nominative and genitive: قاضٍ. It stays in the accusative: قاضِياً. In the dual it stays: قاضِيان. In the sound masculine plural it drops: قاضُونَ / قاضِينَ.
intro.ur: Al-ism al-manqus woh lafz hai jis ke aakhir mein ya (ـيِ) ho aur uske pehle kasra ho, jaise القاضي (qazi). Raf aur jarr mein tanween ke saath ya gir jati hai: قاضٍ. Nasb mein ya rehti hai: قاضِياً. Tasniya mein ya rehti hai: قاضِيان. Jama muzakkar salim mein ya gir jati hai: قاضُونَ / قاضِينَ.
intro.ar: الِاسْمُ المَنْقوصُ هُوَ اسْمٌ مُعْرَبٌ آخِرُهُ ياءٌ لازِمَةٌ قَبْلَها كَسْرَةٌ مِثْلَ القاضي. تُحْذَفُ ياؤُهُ عِنْدَ التَّنْوينِ في الرَّفْعِ وَالجَرِّ: قاضٍ، وَتَثْبُتُ في النَّصْبِ: قاضِياً، وَتَثْبُتُ في المُثَنّى: قاضِيان، وَتُحْذَفُ في جَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ: قاضُونَ وَقاضِينَ.

dialogue.ar: السّاعي عَلى الأَرْمَلَةِ والمِسْكينِ كالمُجاهِدِ في سَبيلِ اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: as-sāʿī ʿalā l-armalati wal-miskīni kal-mujāhidi fī sabīli llāh
dialogue.en: The one who strives to help the widow and the poor is like the one who strives in the way of Allah.
dialogue.ur: Bewa aur miskeen ki madad ke liye daud dhoop karne wala Allah ki raah mein jihad karne wale jaisa hai.

dialogue.ar: خَشَعَ المُصَلّي في صَلاتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: khashaʿa l-muṣallī fī ṣalātih
dialogue.en: The worshipper was humble in his prayer.
dialogue.ur: Namazi apni namaz mein khushu se raha.

dialogue.ar: يَرْضى المُتَخاصِمونَ بِحُكْمِ القاضي.
dialogue.tr: yarḍā l-mutakhāṣimūna bi-ḥukmi l-qāḍī
dialogue.en: The disputing parties accept the judge's ruling.
dialogue.ur: Jhagadne wale qazi ke faisle par razi hote hain.

dialogue.ar: السّاعِيانِ في الخَيْرِ مَحْبوبانِ.
dialogue.tr: as-sāʿiyāni fī l-khayri maḥbūbān
dialogue.en: The two who strive in good are beloved.
dialogue.ur: Neki mein koshish karne wale do afraad pasandeeda hain.

dialogue.ar: كُنْ مِنَ السّاعينَ في الخَيْرِ تَرْبَحْ.
dialogue.tr: kun mina s-sāʿīna fī l-khayri tarbaḥ
dialogue.en: Be among those who strive in good and you will profit.
dialogue.ur: Neki mein koshish karne walon mein se ho ja, tu nafa paega.

title.en: Grammar B: The maqṣūr noun (ending in long alif)

intro.en: A maqṣūr noun ends in a long alif, like العَصا (the stick) or فَتىً (a youth). In the dual the alif becomes ya or waw: فَتَيان, عَصَوان. In the sound masculine plural the alif is dropped and a fatha stays: مُصْطَفَوْنَ. In the feminine plural the original letter returns: فَتَيات, عَصَوات.
intro.ur: Al-ism al-maqsur woh lafz hai jiske aakhir mein lambi alif ho, jaise العَصا (lathi) ya فَتىً (jawan). Tasniya mein alif ya ya waw ban jati hai: فَتَيان، عَصَوان. Jama muzakkar salim mein alif gir jati hai aur fatha rehta hai: مُصْطَفَوْنَ. Jama muannas salim mein asal harf wapas aata hai: فَتَيات، عَصَوات.
intro.ar: الِاسْمُ المَقْصورُ آخِرُهُ أَلِفٌ لازِمَةٌ مِثْلَ العَصا وَفَتىً. في المُثَنّى تَنْقَلِبُ الأَلِفُ ياءً أَوْ واواً: فَتَيان، عَصَوان. وَفي جَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ تُحْذَفُ الأَلِفُ وَتَبْقى الفَتْحَةُ: مُصْطَفَوْنَ. وَفي جَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمِ يَعودُ الحَرْفُ الأَصْلِيُّ: فَتَيات، عَصَوات.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تَحْمِلُ العَصا يا سَعيدُ؟
dialogue.tr: li-mādhā taḥmilu l-ʿaṣā yā saʿīd?
dialogue.en: Why are you carrying the stick, Saeed?
dialogue.ur: Saeed, tum lathi kyun utha rahe ho?

dialogue.ar: كُنْ فَتىً صالِحاً تَنَلْ حُبَّ الآخَرينَ.
dialogue.tr: kun fatan ṣāliḥan tanal ḥubba l-ākharīn
dialogue.en: Be a good young man and you will gain the love of others.
dialogue.ur: Nek jawan ban, tujhe doosron ki mohabbat milegi.

dialogue.ar: اتَّبِعْ سَبيلَ الهُدى.
dialogue.tr: ittabiʿ sabīla l-hudā
dialogue.en: Follow the path of guidance.
dialogue.ur: Hidayat ke raste par chalo.

dialogue.ar: سَمّى سَعيدٌ ابْنَتَيْهِ بُشْرى وَسَلْمى.
dialogue.tr: sammā saʿīdun ibnatayhi bushrā wa salmā
dialogue.en: Saeed named his two daughters Bushra and Salma.
dialogue.ur: Saeed ne apni do betiyon ka naam Bushra aur Salma rakha.

dialogue.ar: ذَهَبْتُ البارِحَةَ إلى المُسْتَشْفى.
dialogue.tr: dhahabtu l-bāriḥata ilā l-mustashfā
dialogue.en: I went to the hospital yesterday.
dialogue.ur: Main kal raat aspatal gaya.

dialogue.ar: ادْعُ لي فَتَيَيْنِ مِنَ الفَصْلِ.
dialogue.tr: udʿu lī fatayayni mina l-faṣl
dialogue.en: Call two young men from the class for me.
dialogue.ur: Mere liye class se do ladkon ko bulao.

dialogue.ar: المُصْطَفَوْنَ مِنَ الطُّلّابِ ثَلاثَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-muṣṭafawna mina ṭ-ṭullābi thalātha
dialogue.en: The chosen ones among the students are three.
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilmon mein se chune hue teen hain.

dialogue.ar: هُنا أَرْبَعُ مُسْتَشْفَياتٍ.
dialogue.tr: hunā arbaʿu mustashfayāt
dialogue.en: Here are four hospitals.
dialogue.ur: Yahan chaar aspatal hain.

q.en: Which word is a maqṣūr noun (ends in long alif)?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz maqsur hai (lambi alif par khatam)?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ اسْمٌ مَقْصورٌ (آخِرُهُ أَلِفٌ لازِمَةٌ)؟

q.en: What is the dual of «فَتىً»?
q.ur: «فَتىً» ka tasniya kya hai?

q.en: What is the dual of «عَصا»?
q.ur: «عَصا» ka tasniya kya hai?

q.en: What does «المُسْتَشْفى» mean?
q.ur: «المُسْتَشْفى» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What happens to the alif in the sound masculine plural, like مُصْطَفَوْنَ?
q.ur: مُصْطَفَوْنَ jaise jama muzakkar salim mein alif ka kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِلْأَلِفِ في جَمْعِ المُذَكَّرِ السّالِمِ مِثْلَ مُصْطَفَوْنَ؟

options: It is dropped and a fatha stays

title.en: Extended reading: The story of Ibrahim
title.ur: Wasee mutala: Ibrahim (alaihis salam) ka qissa

intro.en: The story of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him): his call to his people and his father, how he broke the idols, how he was thrown into the fire and was saved, his talk with the king Namrud, the stars, and his migration to Makkah. Then comprehension and vocabulary exercises.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Nabi Ibrahim (alaihis salam) ka qissa hai: apni qaum aur walid ko daawat, butoun ko todna, aag mein daale jana aur bach jana, badshah Namrud se baat, sitaron ki bahes aur Makkah ki taraf hijrat. Phir samajh aur alfaz ki mashqein hain.
intro.ar: قِصَّةُ النَّبِيِّ إِبْراهيمَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ: دَعْوَتُهُ لِقَوْمِهِ وَأَبيهِ، وَتَحْطيمُهُ الأَصْنامَ، وَإِلْقاؤُهُ في النّارِ وَنَجاتُهُ، وَحِوارُهُ مَعَ المَلِكِ النُّمْرودِ، وَالكَواكِبُ، وَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلى مَكَّةَ. ثُمَّ تَمارينُ في الفَهْمِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ.

dialogue.ar: وُلِدَ إبْراهيمُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ وَنَشَأَ وَتَرَعْرَعَ بَيْنَ قَوْمٍ يَعْبُدونَ الأَصْنامَ.
dialogue.tr: wulida ibrāhīmu ʿalayhi s-salāmu wa nashaʾa wa tarʿaraʿa bayna qawmin yaʿbudūna l-aṣnām
dialogue.en: Ibrahim, peace be upon him, was born and grew up among a people who worshipped idols.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim (alaihis salam) ek aisi qaum mein paida hue aur pale barhe jo butoun ki ibadat karti thi.

dialogue.ar: فَعَرَفَ أَنَّ اللهَ واحِدٌ قَدْ خَلَقَ الكَوْنَ كُلَّهُ، وَأَدْرَكَ أَنَّ الأَصْنامَ لا تُفيدُ؛ فَهِيَ حِجارَةٌ خَرْساءُ لا تَتَكَلَّمُ، وَعَمْياءُ لا تَرى، وَصَمّاءُ لا تَسْمَعُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-ʿarafa anna llāha wāḥidun qad khalaqa l-kawna kullah, wa adraka anna l-aṣnāma lā tufīd; fa-hiya ḥijāratun kharsāʾu lā tatakallam, wa ʿamyāʾu lā tarā, wa ṣammāʾu lā tasmaʿ
dialogue.en: He knew that Allah is One and created the whole universe, and he realized the idols are of no benefit: they are dumb stones that cannot speak, blind that cannot see and deaf that cannot hear.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne jaan liya ke Allah ek hai jis ne saari kainat banai, aur samajh liya ke but kuch faida nahin dete: woh goongay patthar hain jo bolte nahin, andhe hain jo dekhte nahin aur behre hain jo sunte nahin.

dialogue.ar: وَاخْتارَهُ اللهُ لِنَشْرِ الدِّينِ الصَّحيحِ، وَجَعَلَهُ رَسولاً يَدْعو قَوْمَهُ وَيَهْديهِمْ إلى اللهِ.
dialogue.tr: wa khtārahu llāhu li-nashri d-dīni ṣ-ṣaḥīḥ, wa jaʿalahu rasūlan yadʿū qawmahu wa yahdīhim ilā llāh
dialogue.en: Allah chose him to spread the correct religion and made him a messenger who calls his people and guides them to Allah.
dialogue.ur: Allah ne unhein sahih deen phailane ke liye chuna aur rasool banaya jo apni qaum ko bulate aur Allah ki taraf rahnumai karte the.

dialogue.ar: ذَهَبَ إبْراهيمُ إلى أَبيهِ وَحَدَّثَهُ بِكَلامٍ جَميلٍ، وَقالَ لَهُ: يا أَبَتِ.. أَنا ابْنُكَ، وَقَدْ جَعَلَني رَبّي رَسولاً.
dialogue.tr: dhahaba ibrāhīmu ilā abīhi wa ḥaddathahu bi-kalāmin jamīl, wa qāla lahu: yā abati.. anā ibnuka, wa qad jaʿalanī rabbī rasūlan
dialogue.en: Ibrahim went to his father and spoke to him with kind words, and said: O my father, I am your son, and my Lord has made me a messenger.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim apne walid ke paas gaye, unse narmi se baat ki aur kaha: abbajaan, main aap ka beta hoon aur mere Rab ne mujhe rasool banaya hai.

dialogue.ar: فَارْجِعْ يا أَبَتِ عَنْ هذِهِ الأَوْثانِ، وَلا تَعْبُدْ إلّا اللهَ رَبَّ العالَمينَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-rjiʿ yā abati ʿan hādhihi l-awthān, wa lā taʿbud illā llāha rabba l-ʿālamīn
dialogue.en: So turn back, my father, from these idols, and worship none but Allah, Lord of the worlds.
dialogue.ur: Abbajaan, in butoun se ruk jaiye aur sirf Allah ki ibadat kijiye jo tamam jahanon ka Rab hai.

dialogue.ar: فَلَمّا عَرَضَ إبْراهيمُ هذِهِ الدَّعْوَةَ عَلى والِدِهِ، غَضِبَ وَأَبى أَنْ يَسْمَعَ كَلامَهُ.
dialogue.tr: fa-lammā ʿaraḍa ibrāhīmu hādhihi d-daʿwata ʿalā wālidih, ghaḍiba wa abā an yasmaʿa kalāmah
dialogue.en: When Ibrahim presented this call to his father, he became angry and refused to listen to his words.
dialogue.ur: Jab Ibrahim ne yeh daawat apne walid ke saamne rakhi to woh naraz hue aur unki baat sunne se inkar kar diya.

dialogue.ar: وَعادَ إلى قَوْمِهِ بَعْدَ أَنْ تَرَكَ أَباهُ، وَتابَعَ دَعْوَتَهُ إلى الحَقِّ بِصَبْرٍ وَحِلْمٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿāda ilā qawmihi baʿda an taraka abāh, wa tābaʿa daʿwatahu ilā l-ḥaqqi bi-ṣabrin wa ḥilm
dialogue.en: He returned to his people after leaving his father, and continued calling to the truth with patience and forbearance.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne walid ko chhod kar apni qaum ke paas wapas aaye aur sabr aur burdbari ke saath haq ki daawat jari rakhi.

dialogue.ar: أَرادَ إبْراهيمُ أَنْ يُرِيَ الكُفّارَ بِأَعْيُنِهِمْ أَنَّ الأَصْنامَ لا تَنْفَعُ، فَذَهَبَ إلى مَكانِ عِبادَتِهِمُ الَّذي يَحْوي الأَصْنامَ.
dialogue.tr: arāda ibrāhīmu an yuriya l-kuffāra bi-aʿyunihim anna l-aṣnāma lā tanfaʿ, fa-dhahaba ilā makāni ʿibādatihimu lladhī yaḥwī l-aṣnām
dialogue.en: Ibrahim wanted to show the disbelievers with their own eyes that the idols do not benefit, so he went to their place of worship which held the idols.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim chahte the ke kafiron ko unki apni aankhon se dikhayen ke but nafa nahin dete, to woh unke ibadat ke maqam par gaye jahan but the.

dialogue.ar: قالوا: أَأَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هذا بِآلِهَتِنا يا إبْراهيمُ؟ قالَ: بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبيرُهُمْ هذا فَاسْأَلوهُمْ إنْ كانوا يَنْطِقونَ.
dialogue.tr: qālū: a-anta faʿalta hādhā bi-ālihatinā yā ibrāhīm? qāla: bal faʿalahu kabīruhum hādhā fas-alūhum in kānū yanṭiqūn
dialogue.en: They said: Did you do this to our gods, Ibrahim? He said: Rather, this biggest of them did it; so ask them, if they can speak.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne kaha: Ibrahim, kya tum ne hamare mabudon ke saath yeh kiya? Unhon ne kaha: balke is bade ne kiya hai, unse pooch lo agar woh bolte hain.

dialogue.ar: قالَ أَفَتَعْبُدونَ مِنْ دونِ اللهِ ما لا يَنْفَعُكُمْ شَيْئاً وَلا يَضُرُّكُمْ؟ أُفٍّ لَكُمْ وَلِما تَعْبُدونَ مِنْ دونِ اللهِ أَفَلا تَعْقِلونَ؟
dialogue.tr: qāla afa-taʿbudūna min dūni llāhi mā lā yanfaʿukum shayʾan wa lā yaḍurrukum? uffin lakum wa li-mā taʿbudūna min dūni llāh, afalā taʿqilūn?
dialogue.en: He said: Do you worship besides Allah what neither benefits you at all nor harms you? Shame on you and on what you worship besides Allah. Do you not reason?
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne kaha: kya tum Allah ke siwa unki ibadat karte ho jo tumhein na kuch nafa dete hain na nuqsan? Afsos hai tum par aur unpar jin ki tum Allah ke siwa ibadat karte ho, kya tum aqal nahin rakhte?

dialogue.ar: قَرَّروا أَخيراً أَنْ يُلْقوا إبْراهيمَ إلى النّارِ؛ لِكَيْ يَموتَ، وَذَنْبُهُ أَنَّهُ مُؤْمِنٌ بِاللهِ وَحْدَهُ.
dialogue.tr: qarrarū akhīran an yulqū ibrāhīma ilā n-nār; li-kay yamūt, wa dhanbuhu annahu muʾminun bil-lāhi waḥdah
dialogue.en: In the end they decided to throw Ibrahim into the fire so that he would die; his only offence was that he believed in Allah alone.
dialogue.ur: Aakhir unhon ne faisla kiya ke Ibrahim ko aag mein dalen taake woh mar jaye; unka jurm sirf yeh tha ke woh sirf Allah par imaan rakhte the.

dialogue.ar: وَألْقَوْا إبْراهيمَ في النّارِ، لكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَخَفْ؛ لِأَنَّهُ قَوِيُّ الإيمانِ وَسَيُنْقِذُهُ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: wa alqaw ibrāhīma fī n-nār, lākinnahu lam yakhaf; li-annahu qawiyyu l-īmāni wa sa-yunqidhuhu llāh
dialogue.en: They threw Ibrahim into the fire, but he was not afraid, because his faith was strong and Allah would save him.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne Ibrahim ko aag mein dala, lekin woh nahin dare, kyunke unka imaan mazboot tha aur Allah unhein bachane wala tha.

dialogue.ar: قُلْنا يا نارُ كوني بَرْداً وَسَلاماً عَلى إبْراهيمَ.
dialogue.tr: qulnā yā nāru kūnī bardan wa salāman ʿalā ibrāhīm
dialogue.en: We said: O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim.
dialogue.ur: Hum ne kaha: aye aag, Ibrahim par thandi aur salamati ban ja.

dialogue.ar: فَيَقولُ لَهُ إبْراهيمُ: فَإنَّ اللهَ يَأْتي بِالشَّمْسِ مِنَ المَشْرِقِ فَأْتِ بِها مِنَ المَغْرِبِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-yaqūlu lahu ibrāhīm: fa-inna llāha yaʾtī bish-shamsi mina l-mashriqi fa-ʾti bihā mina l-maghrib
dialogue.en: Ibrahim says to him: Indeed Allah brings the sun from the east, so bring it from the west.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim unse kehte hain: beshak Allah suraj ko mashriq se lata hai, tum use maghrib se le aao.

dialogue.ar: وَنَظَرَ إلى السَّماءِ، فَرَأى كَوْكَباً فَصَرَخَ فَنادى: هذا رَبّي.. إنَّهُ جَميلٌ. وَبَعْدَ قَليلٍ اخْتَفى الكَوْكَبُ فَقالَ: لَقَدِ اخْتَفى الإِلهُ. إذَنْ لَيْسَ الكَوْكَبُ إلهي.
dialogue.tr: wa naẓara ilā s-samāʾ, fa-raʾā kawkaban fa-ṣarakha fa-nādā: hādhā rabbī.. innahu jamīl. wa baʿda qalīlin ikhtafā l-kawkabu fa-qāla: laqadi khtafā l-ilāh. idhan laysa l-kawkabu ilāhī
dialogue.en: He looked at the sky and saw a star and called out: This is my lord, it is beautiful. After a little while the star disappeared, and he said: The god has vanished. So the star is not my god.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne aasman ki taraf dekha, ek sitara dikhai diya to pukare: yeh mera Rab hai, kitna khoobsurat hai. Thori der baad sitara chhup gaya to kaha: woh mabud chhup gaya. Pas sitara mera mabud nahin.

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ: لَقَدْ عَرَفْتُ يا رَبَّنا، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللهُ. أَنْتَ رَبّي لا إلهَ إلّا أَنْتَ، وَأَنْتَ لا تَغيبُ أَبَداً.
dialogue.tr: fa-qāla: laqad ʿarafta yā rabbanā, annaka anta llāh. anta rabbī lā ilāha illā anta, wa anta lā taghību abadā
dialogue.en: Then he said: I have come to know, our Lord, that You are Allah. You are my Lord, there is no god but You, and You never disappear.
dialogue.ur: Phir kaha: aye hamare Rab, maine jaan liya ke tu hi Allah hai. Tu mera Rab hai, tere siwa koi mabud nahin, aur tu kabhi ghaib nahin hota.

dialogue.ar: تَرَكَ إبْراهيمُ بِلادَهُ، وَسارَ مَعَ زَوْجَتِهِ هاجَرَ وَوَلَدِهِ الصَّغيرِ إسْماعيلَ إلى مَكَّةَ.
dialogue.tr: taraka ibrāhīmu bilādah, wa sāra maʿa zawjatihi hājara wa waladihi ṣ-ṣaghīri ismāʿīla ilā makkah
dialogue.en: Ibrahim left his land and travelled with his wife Hajar and his little son Ismail to Makkah.
dialogue.ur: Ibrahim ne apna watan chhoda aur apni biwi Hajar aur chhote bete Ismail ke saath Makkah ki taraf chale.

dialogue.ar: فَسَقَتِ الأُمُّ طِفْلَها وَشَرِبَتْ. وَاجْتَمَعَ النّاسُ حَوْلَ ذلِكَ الماءِ (بِئْرِ زَمْزَمَ).
dialogue.tr: fa-saqati l-ummu ṭiflahā wa sharibat. wa-jtamaʿa n-nāsu ḥawla dhālika l-māʾi (biʾri zamzam)
dialogue.en: The mother gave her child a drink and drank herself. People gathered around that water (the well of Zamzam).
dialogue.ur: Maa ne apne bachche ko pilaya aur khud bhi piya. Log us paani (Zamzam ke kunwen) ke gird jama ho gaye.

dialogue.ar: أَمَرَهُ اللهُ سُبْحانَهُ وَتَعالى أَنْ يَقومَ بِبِناءِ الكَعْبَةِ مَعَ ابْنِهِ إسْماعيلَ، فَرَفَعا قَواعِدَ أَوَّلِ بَيْتٍ عَبَدَ النّاسُ فيهِ اللهَ.
dialogue.tr: amarahu llāhu subḥānahu wa taʿālā an yaqūma bi-bināʾi l-kaʿbati maʿa ibnihi ismāʿīl, fa-rafaʿā qawāʿida awwali baytin ʿabada n-nāsu fīhi llāh
dialogue.en: Allah, glorified and exalted, commanded him to build the Kaaba with his son Ismail, so they raised the foundations of the first house in which people worshipped Allah.
dialogue.ur: Allah subhanahu wa taala ne unhein hukm diya ke apne bete Ismail ke saath Kaaba ki tameer karein, to dono ne us pehle ghar ki buniyadein uthain jahan logon ne Allah ki ibadat ki.

q.en: What did Ibrahim's people worship?
q.ur: Ibrahim ki qaum kis ki ibadat karti thi?

q.en: Why did Ibrahim not worship the idols?
q.ur: Ibrahim ne butoun ki ibadat kyun nahin ki?

options: He knew Allah is One and the idols are only stones
His friends told him not to
options_ar: لِأَنَّهُ عَلِمَ أَنَّ اللهَ واحِدٌ وَأَنَّ الأَصْنامَ حِجارَةٌ

q.en: What did Allah say to the fire?
q.ur: Allah ne aag se kya kaha?

options: Be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim

q.en: What is the opposite of «المَشْرِق» (the east)?
q.ur: «المَشْرِق» ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: Which well appeared near Makkah, where people gathered?
q.ur: Makkah ke qareeb kaun sa kunwan zahir hua jahan log jama hue?
q.ar: أَيُّ بِئْرٍ ظَهَرَتْ قُرْبَ مَكَّةَ وَاجْتَمَعَ النّاسُ حَوْلَها؟
